titleEn: Spending in-person time with friends is the biggest predictor of whether college students flourish
titleZh: 与朋友面对面相处，是大学生蓬勃成长的重要预测因素
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: Exercise, avoiding alcohol or even getting enough sleep aren’t the factors most connected to college students’ well-being.
paragraphs.zh: 锻炼、避免饮酒甚至充足的睡眠都不是与大学生幸福感最相关的因素。

paragraphs.en: Spending face-to-face time with friends and other people is the strongest predictor of their mental health, according to a 2026 study of nearly 80,000 students that I conducted with the help of my students.
paragraphs.zh: 根据我在学生的帮助下对近8万名学生进行的2026年研究，与朋友和其他人面对面的时间是他们心理健康的最强预测因素。

paragraphs.en: This finding matters because young people are spending less time together in person and more time communicating through screens.
paragraphs.zh: 这一发现很重要，因为年轻人在一起的时间越来越少，而更多的时间是通过屏幕进行交流。

paragraphs.en: Between 2010 and 2022, the percentage of U.S. high school seniors who reported seeing friends face-to-face almost every day declined from 44% to 32%.
paragraphs.zh: 在2010年至2022年期间，美国高中毕业生几乎每天都与朋友面对面的比例从44%下降到32%。

paragraphs.en: Against this backdrop, mental health challenges among young people have become an increasing public health concern.
paragraphs.zh: 在此背景下，青年人的心理健康挑战已成为一个日益严重的公共卫生问题。

paragraphs.en: Suicide remains the second-leading cause of death among Americans ages 15 to 34.
paragraphs.zh: 自杀仍然是15至34岁美国人的第二大死亡原因。

paragraphs.en: But mental health is about more than the absence of mental illness. My student researchers and I wanted to ask a somewhat different question: What helps young people flourish?
paragraphs.zh: 但心理健康不仅仅是指没有心理疾病。我和我的学生研究人员想问一个有点不同的问题：是什么帮助年轻人茁壮成长？

paragraphs.en: To answer that question, we created a broad measure of well-being that captured more than the lack of mental health problems, such as psychological distress. It also included positive aspects of life, such as having supportive relationships, hobbies and a sense of meaning and purpose.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答这个问题，我们创建了一个广泛的幸福感衡量标准，它不仅涵盖了没有心理健康问题（如心理困扰），还包括生活中积极的方面，如有支持性的关系、爱好以及意义感和目标感。

paragraphs.en: A range of measures to determine well-being
paragraphs.zh: 确定福祉的一系列措施

paragraphs.en: Our research team analyzed responses from 79,246 college students across the United States and Canada.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究团队分析了来自美国和加拿大的79，246名大学生的回复。

paragraphs.en: We examined 51 aspects of students’ lives, including their substance use, the discrimination they encountered, their financial stress, any sleep problems and different relationship challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 我们调查了学生生活的51个方面，包括他们的物质使用，他们遇到的歧视，他们的经济压力，任何睡眠问题和不同的关系挑战。

paragraphs.en: We also examined how students spent their free time, whether that meant exercising, studying, socializing, meditating, playing video games or scrolling on social media.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还研究了学生如何度过他们的空闲时间，无论是锻炼，学习，社交，冥想，玩视频游戏还是在社交媒体上滚动。

paragraphs.en: We used statistical methods that allowed us to compare dozens of potential influences on student well-being simultaneously, helping us identify which factors were most strongly associated with flourishing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用的统计方法使我们能够同时比较数十种对学生幸福感的潜在影响，帮助我们确定哪些因素与繁荣最密切相关。

paragraphs.en: Among the dozens of factors we examined, six stood out as the most important and influential.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们研究的几十个因素中，有六个是最重要和最有影响力的。

paragraphs.en: Time spent with others pays off
paragraphs.zh: 花时间和别人在一起是有回报的

paragraphs.en: The strongest factor connected to student flourishing was remarkably ordinary: spending time with other people. Students who spent more hours socializing with friends, attending student organizations and participating in cultural events tended to report feeling an overall sense of well-being.
paragraphs.zh: 与学生发展密切相关的最强因素是与他人相处的时间，这一点非常普通。花更多时间与朋友交往、参加学生组织和文化活动的学生，往往会报告说总体感觉幸福。

paragraphs.en: The second most important factor surprised us. Students who spent more time on obligations, including paid work and unpaid family responsibilities, also tended to report a greater sense of well-being.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个最重要的因素让我们感到惊讶。那些花更多时间在义务上的学生，包括有报酬的工作和无报酬的家庭责任，也倾向于报告更大的幸福感。

paragraphs.en: Our results raise an intriguing possibility: Well-being may come not only from leisure and self-care but also from contributing to something larger than oneself.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果提出了一个有趣的可能性：幸福感可能不仅来自休闲和自我照顾，还来自对比自己更大的东西的贡献。

paragraphs.en: While problematic substance use, passive screen time and sleep problems tended to compromise well-being, these factors weren’t the biggest detriment. It was difficulty navigating interpersonal relationships, including problems with friends, romantic partners and roommates.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然有问题的物质使用、被动的屏幕时间和睡眠问题往往会损害幸福感，但这些因素并不是最大的危害。难以驾驭人际关系，包括与朋友、浪漫伴侣和室友的问题。

paragraphs.en: Making friends, maintaining healthy relationships and working through conflicts requires practice, and some of that practice time now competes with communication mediated by screens.
paragraphs.zh: 交朋友、保持健康的人际关系和解决冲突都需要练习，而现在，一些练习时间与通过屏幕进行的交流竞争。

paragraphs.en: Notably, the contributors to student flourishing were similar among students diagnosed with anxiety or depression and those without these diagnoses. That suggests these everyday experiences may matter across a broad spectrum of mental health.
paragraphs.zh: 值得注意的是，在被诊断患有焦虑或抑郁症的学生和没有这些诊断的学生中，对学生发展的贡献是相似的。这表明这些日常经历可能对广泛的心理健康有影响。

paragraphs.en: Helping students thrive
paragraphs.zh: 帮助学生茁壮成长

paragraphs.en: Supporting students’ mental and emotional health is not simply a matter of reducing screen time. It also means making it easier for young people to spend time together in person, whether through clubs, recreation programs, community events or other welcoming spaces.
paragraphs.zh: 支持学生的心理和情绪健康不仅仅是减少屏幕时间的问题，还意味着让年轻人更容易亲自花时间在一起，无论是通过俱乐部，娱乐节目，社区活动还是其他欢迎空间。

paragraphs.en: Counseling and educational programs can likewise help students build friendships, communicate effectively and navigate conflict in healthy ways.
paragraphs.zh: 咨询和教育项目同样可以帮助学生建立友谊，有效沟通，并以健康的方式解决冲突。

paragraphs.en: None of this means mental illness can be solved by telling a struggling young person to put down their phone, join a club or get more sleep. Mental health conditions are complex, and people experiencing them need access to effective professional care.
paragraphs.zh: 所有这些都不意味着，告诉一个苦苦挣扎的年轻人放下手机、加入俱乐部或多睡一会儿，就能解决精神疾病。精神健康状况很复杂，经历这些问题的人需要获得有效的专业护理。

paragraphs.en: But our findings suggest that helping young people thrive requires more than treating symptoms. It also requires cultivating supportive relationships, healthy sleep and meaningful engagement in work, school and family life.
paragraphs.zh: 但我们的研究结果表明，帮助年轻人茁壮成长需要的不仅仅是治疗症状，还需要培养支持性的关系、健康的睡眠以及有意义的工作、学校和家庭生活。
